name: Being Yourself
overview: Scripture reveals that being yourself is rooted in the truth that God created each person uniquely in His own image, as affirmed in Genesis 1:27 and Psalms 139:14. Our identity and worth are not found in outward beauty or human approval but in revering the Lord, which brings true honor (Proverbs 31:30). Trusting God’s plans for us (Jeremiah 29:11) and committing our works to Him (Proverbs 16:3) provide the foundation for living authentically and humbly, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:5.
